_note: Special tab rules (ours, make-special.js; spec docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-30-special-tab-design.md 5-7). Periods: spec 5.1 (WW dates; period 1 from the WW launch 2016-04-07, period 5 to the end of service 2021-05-31). Entries pick quests of the private catalogue by series or quest name; evStageId is fixed per entry (stage ids 970000 + (evStageId - 7000) * 10 + i stay stable for the saves). Drops are reconstructed from the family reward text of the wikis (no original drop tables): one drop row per item, num 1 per drop-carrying enemy. Every period (Task 7): a quest that continues widens `periods`; different days, AP or VIP rule -> its own entry (own stages). Optional `from` / `to` (days, inclusive) split a period, checked against the Shop week (special.currentEntries); `objectives` = reconstructed objectives for a catalogue quest without any. banner: file name of the original khuxwiki banner (downloaded by hand into reference\special_banners, local only; make_special_banners.py), empty -> generated plate.
